A real double click produces two click events and then a dblclick event. On the middle card, only the dblclick event increments the counter. The browser does not choose the gesture for you.

Two fingers after pointing mean CLICK, regardless of their direction. To scroll or send arrows, show an open palm first and wait for READY. The cursor stays at the last target.

Scroll inside this box

Point inside the box. Show an open palm until READY, then hold two fingers downward. Point or show an open palm to stop. Show palm again before switching direction.

1 — Start here
2 — Scroll received
3 — Keep scrolling
4 — Almost there

Browser Back / Forward

Open history test page 2, then show palm until READY and two fingers left to return here. Show palm again and two fingers right to go Forward.

The browser must be focused. A grey Back/Forward button means there is no history entry in that direction.
